---
title: "uv-python plotnine ecosystem rendering"
engine: uv-python
format: html
uv-python:
  with:
    - pandas
    - plotnine
execute:
  echo: false
  fig-width: 4
  fig-height: 3
  fig-dpi: 96
  fig-format: png
---

This fixture uses transient `uv-python.with` dependencies. The captioned
plotnine figure is referenced as @fig-ecosystem-plotnine.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ecosystem-plotnine
#| fig-cap: Plotnine figure rendered by uv-python
#| fig-alt: Plotnine ecosystem scatter plot
import pandas as pd
from plotnine import aes, geom_point, ggplot, labs, theme_minimal

points = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1, 2, 3], "y": [1, 4, 9], "label": ["a", "b", "c"]})
plot = (
    ggplot(points, aes("x", "y"))
    + geom_point()
    + labs(title="uv-python plotnine last expression")
    + theme_minimal()
)

plot
```

Explicit `display(plot)` should also produce a single static figure without a
spurious text representation.

```{python}
from uv_python_runtime import display

display(plot)
```
